name: nightly-triage
description: Autonomous nightly bug-triage pipeline: discover → verify → fix → PR → review. Human only at the T2/T3 merge gate.

steps.task: Scan the repository at the current working directory. Find ONE concrete, verifiable code issue (bug, dead code, silent exception, missing validation, inefficiency). Return: file path, line numbers, severity (blocker/warning/nit), and a one-line root cause. Do NOT modify files. If no issue is found, return exactly: NO_ISSUE
